messages:
Riley: Heads-up  planning a progressive rollout for `adaptive_quota_v2` (per-customer quota tuning) to 2% tomorrow. Need: (1) console preview of quota buckets + estimated per-customer cost delta, (2) telemetry + alerts for quota breaches and cost regressions, (3) a safe auto-pause. Tagging @Anya @Marcus.

Anya: Telemetry: per-customer quota-usage p99, overquota_count, average tokens/session, and a sample of rate-limit errors with trace-id. Also capture a 0.02% sample of requests that hit new quota path for quality checks.

Marcus: Auto-pause rules suggestion: pause if overquota_count increases by >50% vs baseline in a 15m window OR if estimated per-minute spend for customers exceeds baseline + 20%. When paused, set rollout state to "PAUSED_AUTOPROBES" and page on-call. No automatic rollback.

Riley: Console UX asks: add a small "Estimated cost impact" banner on rollout page, and a preview table that shows a handful of real customer IDs (hashed) mapped to new bucket + expected monthly delta. Show a snapshot diff modal with checksum and previous snapshot id before apply.

Tao: CLI runbook bits: `redwoodctl config pause --flag adaptive_quota_v2 --reason="auto-pause:quota_spike"` and `redwoodctl config rollback --flag adaptive_quota_v2 --to=snapshot-<id> --reason='manual_rollback'`. Ensure both commands emit audit events with snapshot id, actor, and diff summary.

Anya: Alert pseudo-examples:
```
# overquota spike (15m)
(delta(overquota_total{feature="adaptive_quota_v2"}[15m]) / max(1, baseline_overquota)) > 0.5
```
```
# cost delta per-minute
(avg_over_time(estimated_spend_per_minute{flag="adaptive_quota_v2"}[10m]) > baseline_spend_per_minute * 1.2)
```
Both should map to `quota_regression` alert group.

Marcus: Ops prefers auto-pause + pager on first fire, manual rollback. Add a ticket template that includes rollout id, snapshot id, sample customer IDs affected, and a link to the preview samples.

deploy-bot: Launched rollout job r-1767702345 (dry-run) for `adaptive_quota_v2` cohorts hash [0..2%).

Riley: Action items: Ill mock the preview banner + snapshot modal. Anya will draft alert rules and the small sampler ETL. Marcus will add auto-pause state transitions and ticket payload. Tao will ensure CLI pause/rollback emit audit events. Review tomorrow 11:15. :white_check_mark:
